name: Embedding
aliases: How can different wording find the same topic?
quote: 换了说法，怎么还能找到同一件事？
tagline: 把文本等内容转换为一组数字，用来比较内容之间的关联。
desc: 用户搜“找回账号”，资料写的是“重置密码”。将问题和资料转成兼容的向量后，可以按相似度寻找候选内容。 A numeric representation used to compare relationships between pieces of content. A question about account recovery can match a passage about resetting a password when both use compatible embeddings.

name: Semantic Search
aliases: How does “when will I get my money back” find “refund timing”?
quote: 搜“钱什么时候退”，怎么找到“退款到账”？
tagline: 按含义上的关联查找内容，而不只匹配相同的字。
desc: 知识库里没有“钱什么时候退”这句话，但“退款到账时间”可能是相关候选。检索结果仍需检查时间、适用范围和用户权限。 Retrieving content by related meaning rather than only matching identical words. A refund-timing passage can be a candidate even when it does not repeat the question. Check its date, scope and access permissions.

name: Chunking
aliases: Why did AI find a rule but miss its exception?
quote: AI 找到了条款，为什么漏掉后面的例外？
tagline: 把长文档切成可检索、可放进上下文的片段，同时保留必要的连接信息。
desc: 退款规则和“定制商品除外”被切到两个片段时，单独检索规则可能给出错误结论。按章节和语义边界切分，并保留标题、来源和必要重叠。 Splitting long documents into retrievable passages while preserving needed context. A refund rule and its custom-order exception can land in separate chunks. Preserve headings, source positions and useful overlap.

name: Reranking
aliases: Why is the useful passage below less relevant results?
quote: 搜到的资料不少，最有用的为什么排在后面？
tagline: 对已经召回的候选资料，再按问题相关性重新排序。
desc: 先召回退款相关段落，再把解释“到账时间”的片段排到申请条件之前，让模型优先看到更切题的内容。 Reordering an existing set of retrieved candidates by relevance to the question. For a refund-timing question, move the timing passage ahead of general application conditions.

name: Grounding
aliases: Does a linked answer deserve trust?
quote: 答案有链接，就能相信了吗？
tagline: 让回答中的判断依托可核对的资料，并区分原文、推断和缺失依据。
desc: 项目助手整理活动规则时，每项资格和截止时间都要对上有效原文。相关链接只能说明找过资料，不能说明结论被资料支持。 Connecting claims to inspectable evidence and distinguishing support, inference and missing information. An event assistant should match eligibility and deadline claims to the effective rules, not merely attach a related link.

name: Context Compaction
aliases: Why does AI lose earlier decisions in a long chat?
quote: 聊久了以后，AI 为什么忘了之前的约定？
tagline: 缩减当前会话的历史内容，例如用摘要替换旧消息，为后续任务腾出上下文。
desc: 长时间改网站时，可把已完成改动、决策、限制、文件位置和待办整理进交接摘要，保留最近的关键消息。 Reducing current conversation history, for example by replacing older messages with a summary. During a long website task, preserve decisions, constraints, changed files and pending work while keeping recent critical messages.

name: Prompt Caching
aliases: Must the same instructions be processed again every time?
quote: 每次都发送同一份规则，还要重复处理吗？
tagline: 复用符合条件的重复输入处理结果，减少重复提示前缀的处理开销。
desc: 项目规则和工具定义经常不变，可以放在稳定前缀；用户的新问题放后面。是否命中取决于供应商的匹配、长度和有效期规则。 Reusing eligible processing of repeated input prefixes to reduce repeated work. Keep stable project rules and tool definitions before changing user input. Matching, minimum length and expiry depend on the provider.

name: AI Evals
aliases: How do we know a model change is actually better?
quote: 换个模型以后，怎么知道真的更好？
tagline: 用明确的任务样例和判断标准，系统地比较模型或 AI 工作流的输出。
desc: 项目助手更换提示词后，用同一组脱敏需求检查资料准确性、格式和边界情形，保存输出及版本供比较。 Comparing model or workflow outputs using explicit cases and criteria. Evaluate a revised project assistant on the same redacted requests, checking evidence, format and difficult cases. Keep outputs and versions.

name: Agent Tracing
aliases: Which step caused the agent to stop?
quote: Agent 卡住了，怎么知道是哪一步？
tagline: 按一次任务关联记录模型调用、工具执行和交接等事件，定位实际发生的过程。
desc: 报告助手先检索、再读文件、最后生成。轨迹可以区分检索失败、工具报错和生成中断，避免只看最后一句“出错了”。 Correlating observable model calls, tool execution and handoffs within a task. A report assistant retrieves, reads files and generates. A trace helps distinguish retrieval failure, a tool error and interrupted generation.

name: Computer Use
aliases: Can AI operate a page that has no API?
quote: 没有 API 的页面，AI 能帮我操作吗？
tagline: 让 Agent 通过界面观察和点击、输入、滚动等动作，在浏览器或桌面中执行任务。
desc: 整理一个没有现成接口的后台时，Agent 先看当前页面，再操作并核对结果。它需要可用的执行环境与已授权的访问。 Using interface observations and actions such as clicks, typing and scrolling to carry out a task. For a dashboard without a suitable API, observe its current state, perform permitted actions and check the result in the application.

name: Model Routing
aliases: Must every workflow step use the same model?
quote: 一个工作流里的所有步骤，都得用同一个模型吗？
tagline: 按明确规则，把任务或请求交给合适的模型与部署，并处理允许的回退。
desc: 资料提取、图片理解和最终审稿可能需要不同能力。先核对输入类型、输出格式、预算和隐私要求，再确定每一步可用的模型。 Directing requests to suitable models or deployments using explicit rules and permitted fallbacks. Extraction, image understanding and final review can need different capabilities. Check input type, output format, budget and privacy for each step.
